# Ellines Tech

> Kenya-based IT company — software development, web design, AI, IT consulting, digital marketing, and career documents. Offices in Nyeri and Nairobi. Motto: Your Idea. Our Code.

Site: https://tech.ellines.co.ke
Parent: Ellines Group (Ellines Tech, Ellines Haven, Ellines Rattan)
